test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Two pipes A and B can fill the tank in 40 and 60 minutes, respectively. Both the pipes are opened together. After how many minutes should the pipe B be turned off, so that the tank be fill in 30 minutes?
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A fills the tank in 40 minutes.

Pipe B fills the tank in 60 minutes.

Total time to fill the tank = 30 minutes.

**Formula used:**

LCM of 40 and 60.

Work done = Efficiency × Time.

**Calculations:**

LCM of 40 and 60 = 120 (Total capacity of the tank).</
